title: The direct image of an injective module is acyclic for sections over every open
statement: Let $h:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal I$ be an injective object of the category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Then for every open $V\subseteq S$ and every $p>0$ one has $H^p(V,(h_*\mathcal I)|_V)=0$, where $H^p(V,-)$ is cohomology of $\mathcal O_V$-modules [pqf-def-cohomology]. In other words, $h_*\mathcal I$ is acyclic [def-sp-acyclic] for the left exact functor $\Gamma(V,-)$ from $\mathcal O_S$-modules to $\mathcal O_S(V)$-modules, for every open $V\subseteq S$ (in particular for $V=S$). ($h_*\mathcal I$ need not be an injective $\mathcal O_S$-module, since $h^*$ need not be exact.)

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01EX (lemma-pushforward-injective, line 1779), part (2); its proof uses Cech cohomology of f_*I via the covering f^{-1}(V_j) and Lemma 01EV (lemma-cech-vanish)
